## Context / Problem
`tests/unit/test_snapshot_git_watchdog_d33f.py::test_healthy_calls_still_answer` failed in a Windows sweep (run 44885970695, job 136791396098, Nov 21 2026, branch tmp/f2-win-afunix-05f74084 at d8aa30bc2af): `SnapshotError: git remote in '...\\repo' timed out after 1s`. The scheduled main sweep 44877036143 passed it.

## Root cause (from the code)
The `slow_git` fixture monkeypatches `git_fetch._GIT_TIMEOUT` to `_BOUND_S = 1` for the whole test, and the healthy test then makes 4 real git calls (`has_remote` twice, `resolve_ref`, `rev_parse`) that must each answer within 1 s. That holds on an idle host but not on a loaded one: a Windows git start alone can approach a second. Same class as closed civil-fameless-starfish (a healthy recovery call held to the shrunken 1 s bound).

## Approach
In `test_healthy_calls_still_answer`, after arming the fixture with an unrelated subcommand, restore the module's production bound (`monkeypatch.setattr(git_fetch, "_GIT_TIMEOUT", <value saved before the fixture shrank it>)`) so the healthy calls are judged against the bound production uses. The slowed-subcommand tests keep the 1 s bound, which is what they test. The fixture records the original value as an attribute of the setter it returns, so the test does not hard-code it.

## Scope
- `tests/unit/test_snapshot_git_watchdog_d33f.py`

## Testing
- Reproduction: a PATH git shim that sleeps 1.2 s before every start makes the healthy test fail with `timed out after 1s` before the change and pass after; both runs recorded here.
- The module's other tests (the watchdog-timeout assertions) still pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Under the 1.2 s-per-start shim the healthy test fails before and passes after, runs recorded here.
- [x] The slowed-subcommand tests still use the 1 s bound and pass.
- [x] `make verify` passes and Gerrit gives Verified +1. (Slot verify: only main's then-red encoding guard failed, integration 226 passed; Gerrit 3507 LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 after rebase onto the fix; merged bef7722ff0a)
